messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] org=OrchardBio high QPS spike detected (baseline ~1.2k -> 12k). Errors rising on req-processor: 5xx ~3% and tail latency > 2s. Paging current SRE on-call @Priya.
Priya Kaur: Got it, joining. Any initial mitigation we can apply without customer notice?
Alex Chen: Recommend short emergency org-level rate cap and route-level shaping. Set org RL to 600 rps (down from observed burst) with small burst window. Also limit embeddings and async-precompute routes.
Maya Rodriguez: Can do route-level gating at the edge. Disable embeddings prefetch and throttle /v1/embeddings to 20 rps for OrchardBio. That should cut downstream load quickly.
Jordan Lee: I'll loop in CS and Product ASAP. Jordan -> OrchardBio CSM on standby. What is expected visible impact to them?
Sam Patel: Product needs to know if we'll disable streaming or function-callbacks; those break some flows. Prefer route shaping over hard-disable where possible.
Priya Kaur: Agreed. Plan: 1) Apply org-level soft cap (600rps, burst 1200) 2) Throttle embeddings route to 20rps 3) Keep streaming but enforce per-stream token limit 4) Monitor 5xx and latency. Jordan, please prepare a short FYI message.
Alex Chen: Running admin change now. Command: 
```\
curl -X POST "https://admin.api.redwood.internal/orgs/OrchardBio/limits" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"org_rps":600,"burst":1200,"reason":"emergency traffic spike 2024-11-05"}'\
```
Priya Kaur: Executed. API returned 200 and job_id=job_9b2f. Applying route throttle: 
```\
curl -X POST "https://admin.api.redwood.internal/orgs/OrchardBio/routes/throttle" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","limit_rps":20,"scope":"org"}'\
```
Priya Kaur: Route throttle applied, returned 200. Disabling embeddings prefetch feature flag for org: 
```\
curl -X PATCH "https://flags.api.redwood.internal/orgs/OrchardBio" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_KEY" \
  -d '{"features":{"embeddings_prefetch":false}}'\
```
Priya Kaur: Flag change applied.
Alex Chen: Seeing immediate QPS drop on req-processor tail. 5xx down to 1.1% (from 3%), p95 latency dropping from 2.3s to 0.9s. Link to perf dashboard: https://console.redwood.local/d/ops/org/OrchardBio?from=now-15m
Jordan Lee: Notifying customer now: "We observed an unusual burst affecting latency; we've applied temporary protective limits to restore stability. This may affect embeddings throughput. We'll update within 30 minutes."
Sam Patel: Good. Post-mitigation plan: schedule a postmortem with runtime/infra, and a short-runbook entry for similar org spikes.
Maya Rodriguez: I'll watch gateway queues and KV cache hit-rate; will revert embeddings prefetch only after stable metrics for 30m.
Priya Kaur: On-call handoff: I'll keep the bridge until 3051123900, then hand to eng-sre pager (Alex). If metrics look stable at that time, we'll relax burst to 900 and embeddings limit to 50 rps as a staged rollback.
Alex Chen: I'll pick up after 3051123900 and coordinate the rollback if safe.
incident-bot: [ACTION] Incident annotated: type=org-rl-adjustment, org=OrchardBio, mitigations=[org_cap,route_throttle,feature_flag], owner=Priya Kaur, ticket=INC-2024-3847
Priya Kaur: Closing the active emergency channel here; will post final resolution summary to #postmortems once we do the RCA. Thanks all :thumbsup:
